prompt: # Plan { "intent": "Build a Silver orders table keeping only the latest version of each order by updated_at", "layer": "silver", "strategy": "dedup_latest", "so
text:
```json
{
  "parameters": [
    "orders_table",
    "target_table",
    "watermark",
    "key_columns"
  ],
  "cells": [
    {
      "title": "Read incremental orders changes from Bronze using watermark",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.ingest-incremental",
        "table:orders",
        "standard:notebook.configuration-comes-from-metadata-never-literals",
        "standard:notebook.explicit-schemas-and-column-lists"
      ],
      "code": "from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import StringType, LongType

watermark_epoch = int(watermark) if watermark is not None else 0

source_cols = [
    "order_id",
    "customer_id",
    "order_status",
    "purchased_at",
    "delivered_at",
    "updated_at"
]

incremental_orders_df = (
    spark.read.table(orders_table)
    .select(
        F.col("order_id").cast(StringType()).alias("order_id"),
        F.col("customer_id").cast(StringType()).alias("customer_id"),
        F.col("order_status").cast(StringType()).alias("order_status"),
        F.col("purchased_at").cast(LongType()).alias("purchased_at"),
        F.col("delivered_at").cast(LongType()).alias("delivered_at"),
        F.col("updated_at").cast(LongType()).alias("updated_at")
    )
    .filter(F.col("updated_at") > watermark_epoch)
)"
    },
    {
      "title": "Validate data quality rules before processing",
      "cites": [
        "standard:notebook.quality-rules-run-before-writes",
        "standard:notebook.no-unbounded-collect-or-topandas"
      ],
      "code": "failed_dq_df = incremental_orders_df.filter(
    F.col("order_id").isNull() | F.col("updated_at").isNull()
)

failed_count = failed_dq_df.limit(1).count()
if failed_count > 0:
    raise ValueError("Quality check failed: records found with null primary key or null updated_at.")

valid_orders_df = incremental_orders_df.filter(
    F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & F.col("updated_at").isNotNull()
)"
    },
    {
      "title": "Deduplicate incoming orders keeping latest record per order_id",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.replay",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key",
        "standard:notebook.explicit-schemas-and-column-lists"
      ],
      "code": "from pyspark.sql.window import Window

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("updated_at").desc())

deduped_orders_df = (
    valid_orders_df
    .withColumn("_row_num", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("_row_num") == 1)
    .drop("_row_num")
)"
    },
    {
      "title": "Merge deduplicated orders into Silver target table",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.replay",
        "standard:notebook.writes-are-idempotent",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key",
        "standard:notebook.configuration-comes-from-metadata-never-literals"
      ],
      "code": "from delta.tables import DeltaTable

target_delta = DeltaTable.forName(spark, target_table)

keys = [k.strip() for k in key_columns.split(",")]
merge_condition = " AND ".join([f"target.{k} = source.{k}" for k in keys])

(
    target_delta.alias("target")
    .merge(
        source=deduped_orders_df.alias("source"),
        condition=merge_condition
    )
    .whenMatchedUpdate(
        condition="source.updated_at > target.updated_at",
        set={
            "order_id": "source.order_id",
            "customer_id": "source.customer_id",
            "order_status": "source.order_status",
            "purchased_at": "source.purchased_at",
            "delivered_at": "source.delivered_at",
            "updated_at": "source.updated_at"
        }
    )
    .whenNotMatchedInsert(
        values={
            "order_id": "source.order_id",
            "customer_id": "source.customer_id",
            "order_status": "source.order_status",
            "purchased_at": "source.purchased_at",
            "delivered_at": "source.delivered_at",
            "updated_at": "source.updated_at"
        }
    )
    .execute()
)"
    },
    {
      "title": "Run data verification tests on target table",
      "cites": [
        "standard:notebook.every-notebook-ships-with-tests",
        "standard:notebook.no-unbounded-collect-or-topandas",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key"
      ],
      "code": "target_df = spark.read.table(target_table)

duplicate_keys_count = (
    target_df.groupBy("order_id")
    .count()
    .filter(F.col("count") > 1)
    .limit(1)
    .count()
)
assert duplicate_keys_count == 0, f"Duplicate primary key instances detected in {target_table}"

null_keys_count = target_df.filter(F.col("order_id").isNull()).limit(1).count()
assert null_keys_count == 0, f"Null primary keys found in {target_table}""
    }
  ]
}
```
